newsitem.title: USA: APL expects rate pressures in 1997.
newsitem.headline: APL expects rate pressures in 1997.

text.p: APL Ltd said Tuesday it expected rate pressures to continue through 1997 after experiencing rate reductions in all of its markets during the previous year.
APL, which provides container transportation services, said the pressures would continue due to excess capacity and slow market growth, particularly in the first half of the year.

"However, we are optimistic that our focus on cost reductions and logistical efficiency will continue to produce benefits," it said. "We also expect our effective tax rate to be at or below our 1996 tax rate."
The company said it planned to improve efficiency within its alliances, partnerships and vendor relationships.
It said it was also planning to focus more on its profitable segments like terminals, North America stacktrains and logistics management.

Last year, the company said it had improved volume, the use of ships, equipment and terminals, as well as other major cost reductions, in order to offset the drop in revenue that came with rate reductions.
